versions.content: BlueprintPolicy Blueprintable elements shall be characterized by BlueprintPolicy to indicate whether they will be modifiable or not modifiable. • BlueprintPolicyNotModifiable means, that the related attribute is not modifiable during the blueprinting (see listing 4.1). • BlueprintPolicyList means, that the related attribute is modifiable during the blueprinting. It applies only to an attribute with upper multiplicity greater than 1 (see listing 4.2). • BlueprintPolicySingle means, that the related attribute is modifiable during the blueprinting. It applies only to an attribute with upper multiplicity equal 1 (see listing 4.3).
